evals.prompt: I'm running a study on workplace productivity tools. I need US-based participants who are employed full-time and aged between 25 and 45.
evals.expected_output: The agent fetches the available filter list, then recommends a country or residence filter targeting the US, an employment status filter for full-time employment, and an age range filter with lower bound 25 and upper bound 45. Each recommendation includes the filter_id and the specific values or range to use.
assertions: The agent runs 'prolific filters -n' before making any recommendations
The agent recommends a filter targeting US-based participants and provides its filter_id
The agent recommends a filter for full-time employment and provides its filter_id
The agent recommends an age range filter with a lower bound of 25 and upper bound of 45
The agent provides filter_id values for every filter it recommends
The agent explains why each recommended filter matches the stated requirement
The agent formats at least one recommendation with selected_values or selected_range in the Prolific API JSON structure
